question_text: For a steel alloy it has been determined that a carburizing heat treatment of 15 h duration will raise the carbon concentration to $0.35 \mathrm{wt} \%$ at a point 2.0 mm from the surface. Estimate the time necessary to achieve the same concentration at a $6.0-\mathrm{mm}$ position for an identical steel and at the same carburizing temperature.The unit of the answer is h.
